plugins.name: super-ralph
plugins.description: Design-first autonomous development workflow. /design produces implementation-ready epics with [STORY]/[BE]/[FE]/[INT] sub-issues. v0.11.0 adds --local mode (write entire plan to a single markdown file, skip GitHub) and /improve-design (single-prompt adjustments to existing designs). Fire-and-forget build → review → verify → release pipelines. Domain-aware repair with hotfix flow.

plugins.name: forth-ai-harness
plugins.description: WorkOS-native product-lifecycle harness. Six commands carry a feature from idea to shipped, hook-enforced at every gate: /fspec (interview -> one-page bilingual contract, EARS acceptance criteria, human approval gate), /fbuild (worktree, red-lock-green TDD, fresh-context evaluator, real-stack smoke), /fverify (independent verifier exercises every criterion on the live stack -- local by default, or a real deployed staging host via --staging with a gated magic-otp login -- mocks off, evidence bundle + UAT checklist), /fship (human acceptance, merge and authorship gates, deploy verification), /fstatus (read-only sweep), /flessons (codify recurring lessons). The law: nothing merges without real-stack, per-criterion evidence from an agent that did not build the feature -- no n/a escapes. Domain skills for the WorkOS agent layer and DIKW memory layer ship in the box. GitHub is SSoT; a prose LESSONS.md compounds learning across runs.
